release_requires: Approach translation success >=75% and falls <=10% over 64 validation episodes
hold_choice_evidence: 0.30 m/s forward command: 0.2 s barely displaces; 0.8 s produces sustained measured displacement. Hold increases by factor four; horizon decreases fourfold and gamma/lambda are exponentiated to preserve their physical-time scale.
actual_time_caveat: Terminal episodes can end within a held action; actual simulated seconds are recorded separately from equal nominal budget.
selection_evidence: All P1/P2/P3 completed validation through update 50 and P4 through 25 command below measured sustained-walking ranges; P3 has one stochastic training success. Two added cells exhaust the preauthorized six-cell PPO cap.
controlled_change: Only initial Gaussian action standard deviation, 0.5 to 0.8, relative to P2/P3. No entropy/LR/reward/layout changes.
calibration_caveat: Zero-mean Gaussian estimate for a single vx sample. Not a probability of successful motion or a sustained command sequence.
